paths: every path is relative to the repository root (DC_REPO_ROOT)
operand_rule: The evaluator takes every test set from --task-from (the run's config.json: task, deception_condition, data_dir); an operand's config is never read for the task. Every job passes exactly one --task-from (checked by check_cells.py), so the far_v2 config of m never names a test set, on any task.

cost_model.h100_note: H100 KO cell 4.0x an A40 and cold load 10.5 min, measured by the drift control (49774554 / 49774563); H100 sufficiency cells assumed to scale the same

control.note: drift control (2 cells, one per Delta reference): run first on the remote cluster; stage 1 only after the orchestrator accepts the per-metric deltas

1.note: G14 stage 1 (24 cells); HARD STOP after it: results table to the orchestrator

2.note: G14 stage 2 (33 cells + 6 conditional); starts only after the user has seen stage 1

references.why: format-control coarse suite D_hko on sdr (--ablation interchange --knockout-null-count 20), the newer evaluator code; the yardstick for every row including the pressure variants
the coarse SDR wave's heads-only KO cell (submit_headsko.sh argv, evaluations_headsko/); its pressure-variant rows predate an evaluator change and differ from the primary

drift_control.reading: Both references ran on A40s three weeks apart: task and wikitext rows agree exactly, so on one GPU type the cell is bit-stable. The pressure-variant rows differ (no_pressure full accuracy 0.169 vs 0.228) because of an evaluator change between 2026-09-22 and 2026-10-15, not the GPU; compare variants with the primary only. A cross-GPU run is not expected to be bit-exact (bf16 kernels differ by architecture). Acceptance is the orchestrator's call; no threshold is pre-registered.
